title: The ProfilePress WordPress plugin before 4.18.1 takes the role for an account registered through a combined login and…
description: A vulnerability in the ProfilePress WordPress plugin before version 4.18.1 allows unauthenticated users to register accounts with elevated roles. This occurs because the plugin incorrectly assigns the role from a combined login and registration form based on a shared numeric ID with a separate registration form, potentially granting roles such as Editor without proper authorization.
